title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is a Grothendieck manuscript page; the neighbouring 'pages' supplied are actually SGA 7 IX typescript pages and are unrelated. It is part of the construction of a divided-power ('pd') de Rham cochain complex for semi-simplicial sets.

1. Setup. There is a family of simplicial cochain complexes Φ^{p,*}_*, indexed by an integer p. The lower * is the simplicial degree, the upper * the form degree. p is plausibly a weight (polynomial degree) in a divided-power polynomial de Rham complex on the standard simplices, since the weight-p part has no forms of degree > p; this is a guess.

2. Construction by truncation. Φ^{p,*}_* is obtained from a flasque resolution Φ̃^{p,*}_* of the constant simplicial module k_*. 'Flasque' means each Φ̃^{p,i}_* is extendable, i.e. acyclic for Hom(X,-). One truncates in degrees ≤ p:
- Φ^{p,i} = Φ̃^{p,i} for i < p;
- Φ^{p,p} = Z^p(Φ̃^{p,*}), the cocycles;
- Φ^{p,i} = 0 for i > p.

3. Consequence. For a semi-simplicial set X, define C^{p,*}_{DR_pd}(X,k) := Hom(X, Φ^{p,*}_*). Then:
- Hom(X, τ^{≤p}Φ̃) = τ^{≤p} Hom(X, Φ̃). This holds because Hom(X,-) is left exact, so it commutes with taking cocycles.
- Hom(X, Φ̃) ≃ RΓ(X,k), because the resolution is flasque.
- Hence C^{p,*}_{DR_pd}(X,k) ≃ τ^{≤p} RΓ(X,k).
- So H^{p,i}_{DR_pd}(X,k) → H^i(X,k) is an isomorphism for i ≤ p, and H^{p,i}_{DR_pd}(X,k) = 0 for i > p.
The level-p pd de Rham cohomology thus computes exactly the truncated singular cohomology.

4. New paragraph: base change to a divided-power ring. Let S be a ring with a pd ideal S^+ and an element t ∈ S^+. Define S^{[i]} as the ideal generated by the divided powers t^{(j)}, j ≥ i. After passing to the separated completion, assume S is separated and complete for the topology given by the decreasing sequence S^{[i]', each taken as the closure of the ideal generated by the t^{(j)}, j ≥ i. This is evidently the start of assembling the levels p into one object over S, with weight p weighted by t^{[p]}: a divided-power Rees/completed construction. The page stops before that construction.
errors: No mathematical error is visible. The identification Hom(X, τ^{≤p}Φ̃) ≅ τ^{≤p}Hom(X, Φ̃) is correct by left exactness.
Hom(X, Φ̃) ≃ RΓ(X,k) needs each Φ̃^{p,i}_* to be extendable ('flasque' in the simplicial sense). The page asserts this but does not prove it here.
The page does not say whether the truncated complexes keep the multiplicative pairings Φ^p ⊗ Φ^q → Φ^{p+q}. Truncation is compatible with products, but this is not addressed.
The phrase 'ce topologie défini' is a grammatical slip for 'la topologie définie'.

ideas.what: Level-p truncated pd de Rham cochains of a simplicial set compute τ^{≤p}RΓ(X,k)
ideas.modern_name: Integral/divided-power polynomial forms on simplices (pd analogue of Sullivan's A_PL), with a weight filtration realizing Postnikov-type truncation of cochains
ideas.usually_credited_to: Sullivan (rational forms, 1977); Cartan's divided-power simplicial theories; Cenkl–Porter (integral/tame de Rham theory, ~1980s)
ideas.where_published: Only in this unpublished 1976 IHÉS lecture material, as far as I know; unsure whether lecture notes circulated

ideas.what: Using a flasque simplicial resolution and computing Hom(X,-) of it as RΓ(X,k), with truncation commuting with Hom
ideas.modern_name: Extendable (contractible) simplicial cochain models; canonical truncation τ^{≤p}

ideas.what: Ring S with pd ideal and element t, completed for the ideals generated by divided powers t^{(j)}, j ≥ i, presumably to glue the levels p via t^{[p]}
ideas.modern_name: Divided-power Rees construction / pd-completed filtered (Hodge/Nygaard-type) deformation
ideas.usually_credited_to: Rees algebras are classical; pd-filtered versions appear in crystalline/prismatic theory (Berthelot, Illusie, Bhatt–Morrow–Scholze, Bhatt–Lurie)

missed.claim: Grothendieck starts building a one-parameter object over a pd-complete base S (parameter t ∈ S^+, topology from the ideals generated by t^{(j)}). Its apparent aim is to package all the weight-p truncated pd de Rham complexes of simplicial sets into a single complete filtered cochain model. This would be a divided-power 'Rees' deformation of integral cochains, interpolating the truncations τ^{≤p}. The page stops at the setup.
missed.quote: Soit S [anneau] avec idéal S^+ à p.d., muni d'un t∈S^+. Quitte à remplacer S par son séparé complété pour la topologie engendrée par les idéaux S^{[i]} = idéal engendré par les t^{(j)} (j≥i)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Integral cochain models with divided powers, and pd-filtered (Rees/Nygaard-style) deformations, are active topics: integral homotopy theory, E∞ and divided-power models, prismatic/syntomic filtrations. A 1976 Grothendieck attempt at a pd-Rees model of simplicial cochains would be historically notable if completed in later pages. The idea itself is plausible but routine-looking at this stage.

deep.surprise_reason: The truncation statement itself is routine. Of interest is that in 1976 Grothendieck was building integral divided-power polynomial de Rham models for simplicial sets, sorted by a weight p that realizes cohomological truncation. He then begins a pd-complete one-parameter (t^{(j)}) deformation. This predates or parallels Cenkl–Porter and later integral-model work and is not in his published texts. The page itself contains only setup.
transcription_corrections: 'Φ k_*' is 'de k_*': a flasque resolution of the constant simplicial module k_*.
'[-donc-] en particulier' is probably 'Par suite ... on a ... En particulier'; the crossed-out word before 'en particulier' is uncertain.
'ce topologie défini' is better read 'la topologie définie'.
In the case display, the struck-through symbol before Φ^{p i}_* is a crossed-out duplicate Φ.
